titulo: Several shots and lines in one generation: multishot and dialogue
lead: In 2026, some generators make several shots with cuts in a single generation, keeping the character and light, and they already put the dialogue in the speaker's mouth. This saves you from stitching clips together, but it asks for a more precise script: numbered shots, who says what, and how long each one lasts.
objetivo: write a multishot script of up to 15 s with numbered shots, who says what, and the sound of each shot.

aprende.t: What multishot is and which generators do it as of Oct 2026
Writing numbered shots inside a single generation
Dialogue with who says what, in short lines
When it's better to generate shot by shot

hero_alt: Editing monitor in a dark room with a grid of six frames from the same scene: a dark street, a lit oven, bread on the counter, and a roll-up iron door.

secoes.sub: The multishot script in five parts. Click each one.

nos.detalhe: Scene name, total duration, generator with version (Oct 2026), and the characters who appear. The look comes in through the base prompt from lesson 3.
One line per shot, like in the shot list: size, one movement, duration, and what happens. The size changes between neighboring shots.
Dialogue in the format "Name says: text", short. Two people talking at the same time confuse the generator and the audience.
Ambient sound and effect for each shot, in a separate sentence, as in lesson 2.
The sum of the shots fits within the generator's limit. As of Oct 2026: Kling 3.0 up to 15 s, Seedance 2.5 up to 30 s, Runway Gen-4.5 up to 1 min with several shots.

secoes.legenda: If one shot comes out wrong, multishot redoes the whole generation. Shots you want to control one by one stay out of it.

secoes.sub: The example is the end of "The first batch": the door, the line, and the first customer.

passos.titulo: Who does it as of Oct 2026
texto: Runway Gen-4.5: several shots and native audio, videos up to 1 min (Dec 2025). Kling 3.0 Omni: per-shot control of duration, angle, and movement. LTX-2.5, open: native multishot, according to the official page.
Kling with 6 cuts or 30 s per generation shows up only on third-party sites: treat it as reported and check it in the tool.

exemplo.texto: TechCrunch, 12/11/2025 (Runway); Adobe blog, 04/15/2026 (Kling Omni); Hugging Face, LTX-2.5 (checked on 10/19/2026).

texto: Write it like a short shot list: number, size, one movement, duration, and action. The numbering tells the generator where to cut.
Keep the lock and the look the same across all shots: inside a single generation the generator tends to hold continuity, but it can't guess what you didn't write.

passos.sub: short line of dialogue, with a name
texto: Kling 3.0 launched with dialogue between multiple characters in multiple languages. For any generator, write who is speaking and the text, like in Google's guide: "The baker says: Coming!".
One line of dialogue per shot, and short sentences. A long line doesn't fit in 3 seconds, and the generator speeds it up or cuts it off.

exemplo.texto: sound: door bell; the customer says: The usual, Dona Lia.

texto: Multishot works for short, continuous stretches with the same light and the same people, like a conversation.
Shot by shot (lesson 4) works when each shot needs to be redone on its own, or when the generator you chose doesn't do multishot.

exercicios.titulo: Script · one stretch in one generation
exercicios.texto: Pick 2 to 6 consecutive shots from your shot list that happen in the same place and with the same light. Write the multishot.txt with at least one line of dialogue in the "Name says: text" format, adding up to between 6 and 15 s. Paste it into "Check your multishot script" and download the file.
exercicios.pronto: the page answers OK: [n] shots in one generation · [s] s and the multishot.txt is in the project folder.

exercicios.titulo: Optional · generate and check the clip
exercicios.texto: If your generator does multishot, generate the stretch in 16:9 with the script and the base prompt from lesson 3. Check the file in the lesson 4 clip checker.
exercicios.pronto: the lesson 4 checker answers OK: [s] s · [w]×[h] · 16:9 for the clip and it is in the project folder next to the multishot.txt.

secoes.sub: Four questions. The explanation shows up after each answer.

perguntas.p: What does multishot do in a single generation?
opcoes: It generates several shots with cuts, keeping the character and the light.
It generates the same shot several times so you can pick the best one.
It joins clips you already generated into a single video.
It increases the resolution of a shot you already generated.
perguntas.explica: Multishot is several shots with cuts in one generation. Generating variations of the same shot is something else, and joining finished clips is editing (course 2).

perguntas.p: How do you write a line of dialogue so the generator understands who is speaking?
opcoes: Only the text between quotation marks, without saying who is speaking.
The text in capital letters, so the generator gives it emphasis.
A paragraph explaining what the character feels.
The name of who speaks and a short line, like "The baker says: Coming!".
perguntas.explica: With more than one character in the frame, without the name the generator picks who speaks. The short line fits in the shot; explaining the feeling is the acting's job, not the dialogue's.

perguntas.p: Your multishot in Kling 3.0 adds up to 22 s. What do you do?
opcoes: Send it as is: the generator speeds up the scene to fit.
Cut shots or split it into two generations, because the limit is 15 s.
Switch all the shots to close-ups, because a close-up always takes less time to generate.
Remove the sound column, which is what weighs on the duration.
perguntas.explica: As of Oct 2026, Kling 3.0 generates up to 15 s. Beyond that, split the segment or pick a generator with a higher limit, like Seedance 2.5 (up to 30 s).

perguntas.p: When should you generate shot by shot instead of multishot?
opcoes: When the scene is a short conversation in the same place.
When all the shots have the same light and the same people.
When you need to redo one shot without touching the others.
When the whole scene fits within the generator's limit.
perguntas.explica: In multishot, getting one shot wrong means redoing the whole generation. Shot by shot gives you fine control and works in any generator; multishot shines in short, continuous stretches.

itens.texto: Numbered shots with size, one movement, duration, action and sound.
Who speaks and a short line; one line of dialogue per shot.
Add up the seconds before you generate. If it doesn't fit, split it.
